# Checkbox

Accessible checkbox built on react-aria-components `Checkbox`. The visible box is CSS-drawn over a visually hidden native input; the check and indeterminate marks are inline SVG stroked with `currentColor`. Keyboard behavior (Space toggles), focus management, and ARIA state come from React Aria; visual states are driven purely by RAC data attributes (`data-selected`, `data-indeterminate`, `data-hovered`, `data-pressed`, `data-focus-visible`, `data-disabled`, `data-invalid`) and `--ds-*` tokens.

Import: `import { Checkbox } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Built on react-aria-components `Checkbox`; keyboard behavior, ARIA, and focus management ship inside. All `Checkbox` base props (e.g. event handlers, `isDisabled`, `autoFocus`) are also legal here, with the props listed below overriding or narrowing them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | no | — | Label content rendered next to the box. Always provide a visible label; the whole label is the click target. |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Narrowed from the react-aria-components render-prop form to a plain string; inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |
| `defaultSelected` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the checkbox is selected initially (uncontrolled). |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | no | — | Disables the checkbox: interaction is blocked and the native input is disabled. |
| `isIndeterminate` | `boolean` | no | — | Marks the checkbox as indeterminate ("mixed"): a dash is shown instead of a check and assistive technology announces the mixed state. Typical for a "select all" control over a partially selected set. |
| `isInvalid` | `boolean` | no | — | Marks the checkbox as failing validation; the box takes the danger treatment and the state is exposed to assistive technology. |
| `isRequired` | `boolean` | no | — | Marks the checkbox as required before form submission. |
| `isSelected` | `boolean` | no | — | Whether the checkbox is selected (controlled). Pair with `onChange`. |
| `onChange` | `(isSelected: boolean) => void` | no | — | Handler called when the selection state changes. Receives the next selected state. |

Inherited-but-legal `Checkbox` props (from the registry `racProps` enumeration): `autoFocus: boolean`, `isReadOnly: boolean`, `name: string`, `onPress: (e: PressEvent) => void`, `value: string`. Commonly needed props inherited from the react-aria-components base; the full react-aria-components CheckboxProps surface is also legal.

Theming hooks: `--ds-checkbox-*` component-tier tokens (see registries/tokens-index.json); they belong to this component ONLY (NR-008).

## Accessibility

- Keyboard behavior, ARIA semantics, and focus management come from react-aria-components `Checkbox` — never re-implement or bypass them.
- Interaction states are exposed as data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`, …); the focus-visible ring uses `var(--ds-color-border-focus)` and `var(--ds-shadow-focus-ring)`.
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Checkbox onChange={setAccepted}>Accept terms</Checkbox>
<Checkbox isSelected={allSelected} isIndeterminate={someSelected} onChange={toggleAll}>
  Select all
</Checkbox>
<Checkbox isRequired isInvalid={showError}>I agree to the policy</Checkbox>
```
